proof.text: Intrinsic completeness is invariant under isomorphism: retain the generating family and cochain representative, compose its realization with coefficient extension of the isomorphism, and preserve invertibility of the intrinsic unit by cancellation. This is the proved private helper isoTransportIntrinsicIso.

Derived direct image preserves intrinsic completeness. Apply pbcActualDirectCompletionIso_exists to the actual reflection unit. The unit on the complete source is invertible by full faithfulness of the reflective inclusion. Its image is invertible, hence so is the unit on the direct image by the comparison equation. This identifies that direct image with its complete reflection. Implemented by isoTransportDirectComplete, using the existing proved actual-ring direct-image/completion comparison (Stacks 099N, clauses (1) and (3)).

The ordinary derived pullback along the inverse is an equivalence, by the existing counit-normalized comparison with exact module transport. Its adjunction unit is consequently invertible. Compose the inverse-isomorphism pullback compositor and identity comparison to identify pullback along f followed by pullback along its inverse with the identity. Whiskering the invertible adjunction unit, then this identity comparison, identifies pullback along f with derived direct image along its inverse. Apply direct-image completeness and transport through this isomorphism and e. Only K.property.1 is used; no constructibility, Noetherian-scheme or nonemptiness assumption is introduced.
